messages.text: Got it, so it's a unit you already own. Tell me what it's doing, no power at all, cutting out under load, or fans spinning but no hashing? And if you have the order number handy, that helps me see which unit and PSU shipped to you.
cutting out under load under 4.7  input voltage

That's the supply sagging, not the miner. At 1.8 TH it wants a solid 5V rail, and 4.7V under load means either the PSU can't hold the current or the cable is dropping it. Try a good 5V supply rated well above what the unit draws, with a short, thick cable straight to the wall, no hub or extension.

What PSU and cable are you running it on right now?

If it's the stock supply sagging to 4.7V at stock settings, the PSU is the fault, not the miner. We do PSU-only replacements, so you wouldn't send the whole unit back.

One thing I have to ask first: has it been overclocked or had settings changed at all? Overclocked units aren't covered.

Then it's covered. Fill in the RMA form and note it's the power supply only, with the 4.7V under load, and you'll get a return label. Processing takes up to 10 days once it reaches the warehouse.

https://docs.google.com/forms/d/12t6skK21Qb8GfAdUQ9nOhJ1tVINJ60T3AIAsyhBwnYM/viewform

Put your order number on the form so they can match it to the right unit.
